description.value: 24 Train Express Noodle House is a Vietnamese noodle restaurant located on Nelson Street in downtown Vancouver, offering both indoor dining and a street-facing patio. Its express-style concept and train-themed branding set it apart from the neighbourhood's broader dining scene. Cyclists passing through the downtown core will find it a convenient stop for a hot bowl mid-ride.
